title: Protection & Control Systems Engineer (GRID AUTOMATION)
description:
Job Description Summary

System Engineer is responsible for the execution and implementation of Protection & Control system engineering activities under the technical guidance of the Technical Leader.

The role covers a common job description across CCS, DCS and Consulting, with execution adapted to project scope and discipline.

Job Description

Key Interfaces 

  • Technical Leader

  • Project Manager 

  • Other engineers across CCS, DCS and Consulting Disciplines

  • Manufacturing / MU, Field Service, customers and support functions as needed 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Execute assigned engineering activities for Protection & Control projects in line with the technical strategy defined by the Technical Leader. 

  • Develop discipline-specific technical deliverables such as system configurations (SCADA-screens, equipment integration, communication protocols, digital/analog signals, events, alarms) , equipment parameterization (IED), signal treatment, databases or technical documentation depending on project scope. 

  • Contribute to master file completion, architecture inputs, document updates and technical deliverables preparation. 

  • Prepare and update technical information required for internal and customer documentation packages. 

  • Execute test instructions and participate in pre-FAT, FAT and SAT related activities under project technical governance. 

  • Support identification, analysis and correction of technical issues during engineering, validation and delivery stages. 

  • Collaborate with other engineering disciplines, manufacturing, Field Service and project stakeholders to secure coherent execution. 

  • Maintain traceability of engineering changes, inputs and deliverables within the project execution framework. 

  • Contribute to lessons learned, standardization and continuous improvement actions within the team. 

  • Continuously develop technical knowledge in Protection & Control systems, tools and project execution practices. 

Qualifications / Requirements

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Systems Engineering or similar. 

  • Knowledge of Protection & Control, substation automation or related industrial / utility systems. 

  • Understanding of communication protocols, networks and system integration concepts; programming knowledge is valued. 

  • Strong analytical skills, rigor and willingness to learn in a project execution environment. 

  • Ability to work collaboratively with technical and project teams. 

  • Good command of English; additional languages valued depending on project scope. 

  • Availability to travel up to 30% as required by project, customer, and business needs. 

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience in Electrical Control Systems (ECS) engineering for power generation facilities​
  • Design and implementation of Protection & Control (P&C) systems for gas turbine-driven power plants.
  • IT‑oriented mindset with a proactive approach to learning and applying new technologies.

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: No
